context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes verified end-to-end. Sub-X derivation uses TOURNAMENT_YEAR=2026 hardcoded in backend (/app/backend/server.py line 1373) and frontend (/app/frontend/src/lib/playerValidation.js). When the season rolls to 2027, this constant must be bumped in BOTH places. Director (coach@test.com) and Cuerpo Técnico (ct_smoke2_1780348474@test.com) accounts have team_id=null so they could not exercise the player-creation form via UI; the same validation is enforced server-side and was verified via backend tests covering all three role paths (admin/team/team-club). Director path may need the main agent to seed a team to enable end-to-end UI coverage for those roles, but the security/validation logic is identical.
rca of the issue: Previous regex r'\b(?:19|20)\d{2}\b' on team.category only matched 4-digit years like '2014' or 'Sub-12 (2014)'. Real production teams store category as plain 'Sub-12' with birth_year=null → no match → validation silently skipped → players with any birth year could be saved. Fix adds fallback regex 'sub[\s-]*(\d{1,2})' on category AND team.name, deriving allowed_year = 2026 - X. Same logic mirrored on frontend (BirthDateField hint + realtime error) for instant UX feedback. Backend remains source of truth (POST/PUT both call _validate_player_birth_vs_team).
